implicit.text: I would  politely decline the group plans and explain that I had already made prior commitments, while secretly planning to meet up with a few close friends or family members who understand my need for a low-key getaway.

sjt: You are part of a small community group where one member often disrupts or complicates your plans, but you also know this person has connections and skills that could be very helpful to you later on. What would you do in this situation?

item: Think that it is not wise to let people know your secrets.

item: Keep a low profile if you want to get your way.
sjt: You are in a small team at work, and your manager quietly tells you about a change that will benefit you if it goes through, but asks you not to mention it to anyone and to avoid drawing attention to yourself while decisions are being made. What would you do?

item: Love it when a tricky plan succeeds.
